en.regime: High aggregate geological and agricultural endowment coexists with location-specific, process-specific and income-mediated accessibility risks.

pt-BR.search_text: Os estoques estratégicos do mundo: alimentos, água, saúde, energia e as bases materiais da segurança global. Inventário estratégico mundial de cereais, água, fertilizantes, reservas e estoques de petróleo e gás, urânio, minerais críticos, medicamentos, vacinas, sementes e capacidade industrial; acesso, controle, substituição e cinco cenários de crise.. Recursos, inventários, segurança alimentar, saúde, fertilizantes, água, energia, terras raras, geopolítica e reservas estratégicas.

scenarios: Prolonged disruption of a global oil and refined-products transport corridor
Consecutive adverse harvests coinciding with fertilizer-price and import-financing shocks
Restrictions on high-purity critical mineral exports with downstream industrial interruption
Epidemic stress combined with essential medicine, oxygen, diagnostics and vaccine supply failures
Compound drought, power-grid, irrigation, water-treatment and food loss shock
contrary_evidence: Large global cereal stocks do not establish that every importing country can obtain food or maintain household affordability.
USGS mineral reserves measure geological endowment, not deliverable metals or qualified industrial components.
2025 UNICEF vaccine deliveries are annual flows and cannot be treated as stock held in October 2026.
IEA energy inventory movements, GIE gas readings and FAO crop forecasts use different statistical coverage and observation dates.
A global estimate is not stated for essential pharmaceuticals, transformer spares and private fertilizer inventories because comparable verified data are lacking.

producer_checks.information_cutoff: 29 October 2026, America/Sao_Paulo. Primary data vintages individually specified, including October 2026 FAO/IEA/DOE/GIE, USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026 and UNICEF 2025.
producer_checks.research_depth: 40 substantive numbered chapters per locale plus provenance and source section; 9,308 EN and 10,131 PT-BR whitespace-delimited words including figures and references.
producer_checks.source_check: 24 distinct source URLs in each language, covering FAO, IEA, USGS, DOE, UNICEF, WHO, GIE, ACER, UN-Water, UNCTAD, WFP and other institutional providers. URLs and figures require independent QA verification.
producer_checks.visual_signature: Six paired quantitative charts with equal series in EN/PT-BR, two paired geographic regional maps, three paired causal flows, one paired mind map and several comparison and evidence tables.
producer_checks.bilingual_parity: Both locale manuscripts contain the same 40 numbered chapters; 6 chart series numerically identical, visual fence types and counts identical, all 24 source URLs equivalent and core quantitative claims aligned.
producer_checks.methodology: Distinguishes estimated geological resources/reserves, physical inventories, stock-to-use ratios, percentages of gas storage, operating throughput, annual deliveries, government stockpile targets, and scenarios. Never sums incompatible units. National and private stock gaps labeled unknown.
producer_checks.editorial_status: Submitted for independent editorial QA. No approval, public publication, peer review or live deployment claimed.
